name.zh: 绝灭者，阳雷的业果，晨昏之眼
name.en: Decimator, Karma of Daythunder, Eye of Twilight

zh.name: 绝灭者，阳雷的业果，晨昏之眼
zh.desc: 以霸道统治天空的征服者，被黑潮裹挟后的样貌。往昔的是非功过或许难以评说，但此刻饱含杀意的，只是一团破坏一切的无明业火。

skill_list.skill_desc: <u>修复</u>【枯槁的筛骨】，并对指定我方单体目标造成大量固定数值虚数属性伤害，并使其陷入【<u>腐化</u>】，【<u>腐化</u>】数值可叠加。

240150105.name: 修复
240150105.desc: 解除指定敌方目标的控制类负面状态与弱点击破状态，若此时指定敌方目标处于不可选中状态，则使其重新进入可选中状态。

240150202.name: 腐化
240150202.desc: 可回复的生命上限降低。

skill_list.skill_desc: <u>修复</u>【干涸的泪骨】，并对我方全体目标造成大量固定数值虚数属性伤害，伤害由目标<u>平均分摊</u>。

240150105.name: 修复
240150105.desc: 解除指定敌方目标的控制类负面状态与弱点击破状态，若此时指定敌方目标处于不可选中状态，则使其重新进入可选中状态。

401301001.name: 平均分摊
401301001.desc: 本次攻击结算前的伤害和负面效果由所有受击目标平均承受。

skill_list.skill_desc: 进入【暗潮将至】状态，下次行动施放【烬灰死寂•诸神屠灭】，并<u>修复</u>【枯槁的筛骨】和【干涸的泪骨】。

240150105.name: 修复
240150105.desc: 解除指定敌方目标的控制类负面状态与弱点击破状态，若此时指定敌方目标处于不可选中状态，则使其重新进入可选中状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体目标造成大量固定数值虚数属性伤害，并<u>修复</u>【枯槁的筛骨】和【干涸的泪骨】。

240150105.name: 修复
240150105.desc: 解除指定敌方目标的控制类负面状态与弱点击破状态，若此时指定敌方目标处于不可选中状态，则使其重新进入可选中状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 本次战斗中，对【枯槁的筛骨】或【干涸的泪骨】造成伤害时，【绝灭者，阳雷的业果，晨昏之眼】也会损失相等的生命值。当【枯槁的筛骨】或【干涸的泪骨】受到致命攻击时，【绝灭者，阳雷的业果，晨昏之眼】会受到韧性伤害，且【枯槁的筛骨】或【干涸的泪骨】回复生命值并进入不可被选中状态。
在行动序列上添加【黑潮】，每次【黑潮】行动时，将使我方全体目标陷入【<u>腐化</u>】，【<u>腐化</u>】数值可叠加。当我方角色受到致命伤害时，将陷入【<u>黑蚀</u>】状态；当我方全体目标陷入【<u>黑蚀</u>】状态或无法战斗状态时，战斗失败。

240150201.name: 黑蚀
240150201.desc: 处于【黑蚀】状态下的目标无法被选中，无法行动。

240150202.name: 腐化
240150202.desc: 可回复的生命上限降低。

skill_list.skill_desc: 本场战斗中，【绝灭者，阳雷的业果，晨昏之眼】造成的所有伤害会基于【黑潮同步率】造成固定数值伤害，我方目标攻击后，会再基于【黑潮同步率】造成<u>真实伤害</u>，该伤害<u>【不致命】</u>。当【绝灭者，阳雷的业果，晨昏之眼】和【黑潮】行动时，将增加【黑潮同步率】，当【枯槁的筛骨】或【干涸的泪骨】被击杀时，会减少【黑潮同步率】。

10000017.name: 真实伤害
10000017.desc: 不受任何效果所影响的无属性伤害，本次伤害不视为造成了1次攻击。

401403001.name: 不致命
401403001.desc: 目标受到伤害时，若目标生命值不足，则会将生命值降低至1点。

skill_list.skill_desc: <u>修复</u>【枯槁的筛骨】，并对指定我方单体目标造成大量固定数值虚数属性伤害，并使其陷入【<u>腐化</u>】，【<u>腐化</u>】数值可叠加。

en.name: Decimator, Karma of Daythunder, Eye of Twilight
en.desc: The image of the conqueror who once ruled the skies with absolute might, now consumed by the black tide. The rights and wrongs of their past may be difficult to judge, but at this moment, all that remains is a formless blaze of karmic destruction, seething with murderous intent.

skill_list.skill_desc: <u>Reinstates</u> the "Languid Ethmoid Bone" and deals a set amount of massive Imaginary DMG to one designated target, while inflicting "<u>Rot</u>" to them. "<u>Rot</u>" is stackable.

240150105.name: Reinstate
240150105.desc: Dispels the Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken state from designated friendly units. If the designated friendly units are not currently selectable, causes them to become selectable.

skill_list.skill_desc: <u>Reinstates</u> the "Dried Lacrimal Bone" and deals a set amount of massive Imaginary DMG to all targets. The DMG is <u>distributed evenly</u> among the targets.

240150105.name: Reinstate
240150105.desc: Dispels the Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken state from designated friendly units. If the designated friendly units are not currently selectable, causes them to become selectable.

401301001.name: Even Distribution
401301001.desc: The DMG and debuff before this attack's finalization is received evenly by all targets that are hit.

skill_list.skill_desc: Enters "The Dark Tides Cometh" state. Uses "Unmaking Ashes: Godsfall" in the next action, and <u>reinstates</u> the "Languid Ethmoid Bone" and "Dried Lacrimal Bone".

240150105.name: Reinstate
240150105.desc: Dispels the Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken state from designated friendly units. If the designated friendly units are not currently selectable, causes them to become selectable.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals a set amount of massive Imaginary DMG to all targets, and <u>reinstates</u> the "Languid Ethmoid Bone" and "Dried Lacrimal Bone".

240150105.name: Reinstate
240150105.desc: Dispels the Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken state from designated friendly units. If the designated friendly units are not currently selectable, causes them to become selectable.

skill_list.skill_desc: When inflicting DMG to "Languid Ethmoid Bone" or "Dried Lacrimal Bone" during this battle, an equal amount of HP will also be lost by "Decimator, Karma of Daythunder, Eye of Twilight." When "Languid Ethmoid Bone" or "Dried Lacrimal Bone" receive a killing blow, "Decimator, Karma of Daythunder, Eye of Twilight" will receive Toughness DMG, and "Languid Ethmoid Bone" or "Dried Lacrimal Bone" will restore HP and cannot be selected.

Adds "Black Tide" to Action Order. Every time the "Black Tide" takes action, inflicts all targets with "<u>Rot</u>." "<u>Rot</u>" is stackable. When targets suffer killing blows, inflicts "<u>Tide-Corrosion</u>" on them and Charges "Healing Rainbow." When all targets enter the "<u>Tide-Corrosion</u>" state or are downed, the battle ends in defeat.

240150201.name: Tide-Corrosion
240150201.desc: Targets with the "Tide-Corrosion" state cannot be selected and cannot take action.

skill_list.skill_desc: During this battle, all DMG dealt by "Decimator, Karma of Daythunder, Eye of Twilight" will deal a set amount of DMG based on "Black Tide Sync Rate." After a target uses an attack, additionally deals "<u>Non-fatal</u>" <u>True DMG</u> based on "Black Tide Sync Rate." When "Decimator, Karma of Daythunder, Eye of Twilight" and "Black Tide" take action, increases "Black Tide Sync Rate." When "Languid Ethmoid Bone" or "Dried Lacrimal Bone" is defeated, reduces "Black Tide Sync Rate."

10000017.name: True DMG
10000017.desc: Non-Type DMG that is not affected by any effects. This DMG is not considered as launching 1 attack.

401403001.name: Non-fatal
401403001.desc: When the target receives DMG, if their HP is insufficient, reduces their HP to 1.
